title: 7 Dealer Tricks When Buying a Truck in 2026 (The Rule That Would Have Stopped Them Died)
description:
One in three new vehicle quotes in America now includes dealer add-ons that the buyer did not ask for, averaging about one thousand four hundred fifty dollars. Ram buyers saw the highest, at one thousand nine hundred. In one state, the average document fee is almost one thousand dollars, while in another it is eighty-five. And a federal rule that was supposed to stop many of these tricks was thrown out by a court. Here are seven dealer tricks to watch for when you buy a truck.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

0:00 Intro
1:15 1. The monthly payment question
3:23 2. Pre-installed add-ons
5:45 3. The doc fee
7:25 4. The market adjustment
9:10 5. The trade-in shuffle
10:42 6. The finance office menu
12:26 7. Urgency
13:59 The rule that never arrived
19:29 Your checklist for 2027
